hero.label: ABOUT KLICK-PRO
hero.title: Empowering honest work through trust & transparency
hero.description: Klick-Pro is a milestone-based service marketplace designed to connect clients with verified professionals across India, backed by secure escrow protection and clear accountability.

cards.title: Trust & ID Verification
cards.description: Every professional undergoes identity and credential verification so clients hire with total confidence and peace of mind.

cards.title: Guaranteed Escrow Protection
cards.description: Milestone payments remain safely deposited in escrow before work begins and are released only when deliverables are approved.

cards.title: Built for Both Sides
cards.description: Clients receive reliable work without haggling, while professionals grow sustainable businesses without chasing unpaid invoices.

cards.title: Fair & Transparent Pricing
cards.description: Clear milestones, transparent pricing, and low platform commissions with zero hidden charges or surprise deductions.

cards.title: Community-Driven Reputation
cards.description: Only clients with completed, paid projects can leave ratings and reviews, ensuring 100% genuine reputation across the platform.

cards.title: Dedicated Support & Mediation
cards.description: A dedicated support team and built-in dispute resolution protect both parties and ensure fair outcomes if issues ever arise.
